intro: You get a product clip from a short note, a product link, or a photo you upload. AIVideosUGC adds an AI person from the actor library, a list of faces you can pick. The voice is spoken, and the mouth moves with the words. That match of mouth and words is lip sync. You also get on-screen captions, and a clip you can edit before you download.

It is built for store ads and product pages. You can switch language. You can send the file to TikTok or Meta. You can run a batch, many clips at once, across the products you list. steps_h2: How to Create AI Videos in 3 Simple Steps
steps_lead: Go from a product link or a photo to a clip you can post.

steps.d: Upload a photo or paste a product link, and say who the clip is for.
The video agent, a chat helper, asks what you are selling, which voice to use, and how it should look, then writes the script.
You get the script, an AI person, a voice, the scenes (the parts of the clip), and on-screen captions, ready for TikTok or Meta.

faq.q: How do I create an AI video?
faq.a: Upload a photo or paste a product link. Tell the video agent, a chat helper, who the clip is for. Then download the file. You get a script, an AI person, a voice, the parts of the clip, and on-screen captions. You see the credit cost before it starts.

faq.q: How do I describe the video?
faq.a: Say what the product is, who it is for, and what should happen on screen. The video agent, a chat helper, can turn that note into a full script. A clear, well-lit photo of the whole item still helps.

faq.q: Can I make a news-style video?
faq.a: Yes. You can pick a news-style tone, a voice, a setting, a video shape, a language, and a length. The tool then writes the script. You can also make a promo, a how-to, or a product story. Lengths are 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds.

faq.q: How does the generator build the clip?
faq.a: You enter the idea and choose the tone, the style, and where the clip will run. AIVideosUGC writes the script, makes the pictures, and hands back a clip you can edit.

faq.q: What is this generator built for?
faq.a: It is for store ads and product pages. You start from a photo or a product link. You pick an AI person and a voice. Then you can send the clip to TikTok or Meta. It only makes clips about the product you sell.

faq.q: What kind of voices can I use?
faq.a: An AI voice, with lip sync, so the mouth moves with the words. Try a brighter voice or a lower one. You can switch language when the buyers are not local. The on-camera person is made by AI, not a customer.

faq.q: Do I need to install software?
faq.a: No. You work in the browser. The editor, on-screen captions, and the music library are on the same clip. Download when you want a file. It has no watermark.

faq.q: Can I generate a video from a photo I already have?
faq.a: Yes. Upload one clear photo you have the right to use. The product in the clip comes from that picture. You can also paste a product link instead.

Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits. Pro is $35 for 300 credits. Premium is $63 for 600 credits. Credits are the units in your plan. A 6-second clip uses 24 credits. A 10-second clip uses 40. A 15-second clip uses 60. A 30-second clip uses 120. If making the clip fails, those credits come back.

faq.q: Do these clips work for ads?
faq.a: You can run them as ads you pay for, or as posts you do not pay to boost. Results depend on the product and the audience. Use them to test the opening. Keep a filmed ad when you want a real customer on camera.

faq.q: Can I start from a product page link?
faq.a: Yes. Paste the product link and the tool drafts the script, the on-camera person, and the voice. The same steps are on the [product link to video](page:url-to-video) page if you want them on their own.

faq.q: Can I make several versions to test?
faq.a: Yes. Keep the photo and change the opening, the on-camera person, the voice, or the video shape. Each version is one clip, and the credit cost shows before it starts.

faq.q: Can I run the clip on TikTok or Meta?
faq.a: Yes. Send the clip to TikTok or Meta, or download it and post it yourself. Shapes are tall (9:16), square (1:1), wide (16:9), 4:3, and 3:4. Do not post an AI person as a customer review. Add any label the platform asks for.

faq.q: What is included for an ecommerce ad?
faq.a: You start with a product photo or a link. You get an AI person from the actor library, an AI voice, on-screen captions, and more than one language. You can send the clip to TikTok or Meta. Plans start at $24.50 a month. You can use the file in ads, and it has no watermark.

faq.q: Which kind of video tool should I open?
faq.a: Open the tool that fits the clip: a still photo turned into motion, a spoken ad, a product demo, an unboxing, or an on-camera person. You do not type another company's model name. A model name here means their video engine, not a person. The list is under Explore AI Video Tools for Store Clips.

faq.q: How long does a video take?
faq.a: There is no fixed wait. It depends on the length and how many other tasks are ahead of yours. On-screen captions, the voice, and a song from the music library are part of the clip. You can still change them in the editor.
